purpose: Define bounded evidence required for rebuilt Level 1 target-iPhone core-fun review without pretending automated checks prove human comprehension or fun.
human_acceptance_questions: Could a fresh player infer the first useful action without explanation?
Did visible geometry predict which movement was legal?
Did actual car motion match the visible rule?
Was interaction responsive and satisfying enough to continue?
If failure occurred, could the player explain why?
automation_limits: Automated CI may validate this contract and technical evidence shape only.
Automated CI must not mark P1-009 PASS.
Synthetic timing, solver success, browser automation, or numeric metrics do not substitute for fresh-player target-iPhone judgment.
